title: ACH Payment Discount Window for Fleet Accounts — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Window schedule.** On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders fleet invoice, the discount window — the calendar days after the invoice date within which payment in full earns the early-payment discount — follows how the invoice was paid and the terms:

| Latest payment on the invoice made by | Account | Discount window |
|---|---|---|
| ACH | Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 15 calendar days |
| ACH | Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 12 calendar days |
| Any other method, or any other account | — | the tier's early-payment window; no change applies |

The latest payment on the invoice is the latest payment received on that repair order; the invoice date is the latest line date of its labor charges.

**Edges (hypothetical, Net 30, paid by ACH, invoice dated 4 March).** Paid in full on 19 March — 15 days, inside; on 20 March — 16 days, outside.
